applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: This pada may carry Chitra's design intelligence beneath appearances and through complex or changing material.
You may refine an idea most effectively through private research and sustained attention to details that are not immediately visible.
Private refinement may become fixation when unresolved details keep the work hidden long after its central form is coherent.
Development may involve honoring depth and privacy while recognizing when the work is ready to enter a more visible form.

prohibitedExtensions: claim that the pada overrides the parent nakshatra

Development may involve choosing freedom that is guided by meaning rather than movement pursued only for its own sake.
